description: This file is a Python script used to seed (populate) a database with initial sample data for a sports telecast backend application. It includes functions to insert data for users, teams, events, matches, emojis, highlights, match events, and user reactions, primarily for development and testing purposes.

classes.name: MatchEventDB
classes.description: Database model for match events (goals, cards, etc.).

classes.name: UserEmojiReactionDB
classes.description: Database model for user emoji reactions.

methods.name: seed_database()
methods.description: Main function to orchestrate the database seeding process.

methods.name: seed_emojis(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Seeds emoji asset data into the database.

methods.name: seed_teams(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Seeds team data into the database.

methods.name: seed_events(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Seeds event data into the database.

methods.name: seed_matches(session: AsyncSession, teams: dict, events: dict, team_uuids: dict, event_uuids: dict)
methods.description: Seeds match data into the database.

methods.name: seed_users(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Seeds user data into the database.

methods.name: seed_match_events(session: AsyncSession, matches: dict, teams: dict, match_uuids: dict, team_uuids: dict)
methods.description: Seeds detailed match event data such as goals and cards.

methods.name: seed_user_emoji_reactions(session: AsyncSession, users: dict, emojis: dict, emoji_uuids: dict)
methods.description: Seeds user reactions (emoji responses) to match events.

ctags.name: seed_match_events
ctags.pattern: /^async def seed_match_events(session: AsyncSession, matches: dict, teams: dict, match_uuids: dict/
ctags.signature: (session: AsyncSession, matches: dict, teams: dict, match_uuids: dict, team_uuids: dict)

ctags.name: seed_matches
ctags.pattern: /^async def seed_matches(session: AsyncSession, teams: dict, events: dict, team_uuids: dict, event/
ctags.signature: (session: AsyncSession, teams: dict, events: dict, team_uuids: dict, event_uuids: dict)

ctags.name: seed_user_emoji_reactions
ctags.pattern: /^async def seed_user_emoji_reactions(session: AsyncSession, users: dict, emojis: dict, emoji_uuid/
ctags.signature: (session: AsyncSession, users: dict, emojis: dict, emoji_uuids: dict)
